name: Kanojo to Ore to Koibito to. Mihagino Ayano After
original_name: 彼女と俺と恋人と。美萩野綾乃 アフター
source: Ayano Mihagino, who has become the girlfriend of the main character Haruto, has started living with him in his room. The time they spend together is very cheerful and peaceful, full of smiles. The happy time with Ayano goes on and on.
